title.narrative: NDC Pre-Feasibility Support (NDC-PFS)

description.narrative: On the advice of the NDCP, the project idea has been revised to focus on "Support to develop a pipeline of investment-ready projects and associated documents," aligning with Vanuatu's Nationally Determined Contributions (NDC). The project will deliver six key outputs: the development of three bankable projects aligned with national goals, capacity development workshops for government staff, the creation of project information summaries and presentation materials, initial outreach to potential funders, hands-on training for government officers in project development and portfolio management, and a gender and vulnerable group assessment to ensure inclusivity. These outputs are designed to enhance Vanuatu's capacity to develop, finance, and implement climate-resilient projects, ensuring sustainable and equitable outcomes.

The project’s overall objective is to build a pipeline of preliminary, investment-ready project documents that advance Vanuatu’s NDC commitments and align with national development priorities. By preparing seven project concepts across key sectors, the initiative provides a strong foundation for attracting climate finance and guiding future detailed feasibility work.At the same time, the project aims to strengthen government capacity to mobilize resources, manage projects effectively, and integrate gender and social inclusion into climate action. Through training, outreach to funders, and stakeholder engagement, the project ensures country ownership and supports Vanuatu in turning its climate ambitions into concrete, financeable actions.
